{{Quote|Stock prices not doing so well since the Onslaught, eh, Jervo?''"<br />"''One factory after another, blown away. I don' think they'll be able to tell there ever was a ''colony'' on Wayland, much less a factory!|Haydel Goravvus and Jervo Thalien|<ref name="KOTOR 23" />}}
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] was '''attacked''' by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in [[3963 BBY]], during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces launched from the occupied planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] devastated Wayland, wiping out the planet's colonists and a number of factories owned by [[Lhosan Industries]].<ref name="KOTOR 23" /> After Wayland, the Mandalorians moved on to the planet [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].<ref name="Atlas" />
